sections.description: A self-hosted Critical CSS generator. Add the [mbr_critical_css] shortcode to any page: your server fetches the target page and its stylesheets, and the visitor's own browser renders it at the chosen viewport and extracts the above-the-fold CSS, then checks the result against the full render. Works on shared hosting, with no Node.js or headless Chrome. No premium tier, no upsells, no tracking, GPL licensed.
sections.changelog:
1.2.1

  • Initial public release.
  • Critical CSS for any public page at any viewport, extracted in the visitor's own browser, with no Node.js or headless Chrome needed.
  • Built-in layout & style check comparing a critical-only render with the full page.
  • Hardened for public use: per-request budgets and deadline, atomic per-IP rate limiting, a cap on simultaneous jobs and a sandboxed, restricted preview.
  • Self-hosted updates through Plugin Update Checker.
sections.installation: Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/ and activate it. Add the [mbr_critical_css] shortcode to any page, and adjust access, rate limiting and simultaneous jobs under Settings → Critical CSS Generator.
